item.skt: shrI tsakra saM ba ra pany+tsa kra ma
item.coloph: dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa/ slob dpon chen po mkhas pa rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi paN+Di ta kiSh+Na pa dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/ /phyis bla ma su ma ti kAirti dang / /dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bcas pa'o/ /dpal pham mthing pa'i rgyud pa ma nor ba'i bshad pa'o
